story.title: The Worm changes sides
story.headline:
Detroit.
San Antonio. Chicago.
story.subtitle: Two Rodman trades, Elliott’s return, and the small considerations that a headline leaves out.
story.coverage: Rodman’s 1993 and 1995 exchanges, the separate same-day Morris deal, and Elliott’s completed July 1994 return. Stops October 2, 1995. Conditional seconds and swap outcomes are untraced; the additional 1995 consideration is explicitly undisclosed.
story.takeaway: Elliott returned to San Antonio before Rodman left. These are separate completed exchanges, not a reversal that erased the first package.

c3-det94-rodman-swap.name: 1994 DET swap right
c3-det94-rodman-swap.conditions: San Antonio may exchange firsts: top 10 protected in 1994, top 8 in 1995, unprotected in 1996.

c3-det94-rodman-second.name: Detroit 1994 second-round consideration
c3-det94-rodman-second.conditions: Detroit’s 1994 second-round consideration is included in the documented return. The original conditional trigger is not confirmed by the accessible sources; its subsequent trade and selection are untraced.

c3-sas97-morris-second.name: Conditional 1997 second: Morris deal
c3-sas97-morris-second.conditions: A conditional 1997 second-round consideration in the separate Isaiah Morris exchange. The published report does not disclose its trigger. No conveyance or expiration is asserted.

c3-sas97-elliott-second.name: 1997 second: Elliott return
c3-sas97-elliott-second.conditions: A 1997 San Antonio second-round consideration sent with Bill Curley’s rights for Sean Elliott. The cited completed report does not disclose additional conditions. It is not assumed identical to the earlier Morris conditional obligation; both contracts’ relationship is untraced.

c3-rodman95-other.name: Undisclosed additional consideration
c3-rodman95-other.detail: Chicago sent additional consideration to San Antonio. The Spurs’ guide and contemporary UPI report confirm its existence; neither team disclosed its nature in the cited contemporary report. It is not labeled cash or assigned an invented value.

transactions.title: Detroit and San Antonio exchange forwards.
transactions.text: Rodman goes to the Spurs. Elliott and Wood go to Detroit, while San Antonio also receives draft consideration with a protected swap.
notes: The companion Isaiah Morris exchange is recorded separately, following the contemporaneous Associated Press account. Later team summaries combine the two same-day exchanges.
The 1994 second’s original conditional trigger is unconfirmed here. The protected swap’s possible 1994–96 years are not represented as three different first-round assets.

transactions.title: A separate exchange on the same day.
transactions.text: Detroit sends Morris to San Antonio for a conditional second. It accompanies the Rodman news, but has its own consideration.

transactions.title: Elliott returns before Rodman leaves.
transactions.shortTitle: Sean Elliott goes back to San Antonio
transactions.text: Detroit sends Elliott back to San Antonio. The Spurs send Curley’s draft rights and a 1997 second-round consideration.
notes: The completed July 19 report and later Spurs transaction ledger are used. An earlier guide’s player biography lists July 18. The canceled February 1994 Houston proposal is not a completed trade and creates no edge.

transactions.title: The Worm changes sides.
transactions.text: Chicago acquires Rodman from San Antonio. Perdue and an undisclosed additional consideration go to the Spurs.
notes: The Spurs ledger and contemporary completed report give October 2. The additional consideration is preserved as undisclosed. Jack Haley’s separate free-agent signing is not placed in this exchange.
